# Copies of the web libraries the GCS, projector and planner use

Served at `/vendor/...` by both the GCS backend and the game server, so the pages work without internet.
Unchanged copies; to update one, download the new version over the old files.

| Folder | What | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leaflet/` | Leaflet, the map | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `leaflet-contextmenu/` | right-click menu for Leaflet | 1.4.0 | MIT |
| `toastify/` | the pop-up messages | 1.12.0 | MIT |
| `fontawesome/` | Font Awesome Free icons | 6.5.1 | icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT |
| `fonts/` | Poppins and Playfair Display, from Google Fonts | 2026-10-23 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
